# Boolean host attributes are component state, with CSS as their current consumer

The row documents expanding and expanded boolean attributes; current CSS reads their presence on :host to adjust padding/gap. The row class itself has no observedAttributes or attributeChangedCallback in the inspected full class. Preserve the attribute-versus-property boundary when changing this component. A CSS presence attribute is not automatically an ARIA expanded state; accessible expansion belongs to actual controlling UI and requires separate checks. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: calendar row state naming.
